config.note: Codes confirmed against the source's own category list, not guessed. C211 is the active-ingredient stage, C212 the finished dose. The unit is pinned to I15 because the dataset also carries 2021=100 and 2010=100 — mixing them would silently blend three different bases. Covers human and veterinary pharma together; Eurostat publishes no veterinary-only split.
